quarterly_data.quarter: Ciena press release: Ciena Announces Fiscal Year 2029 Financial Targets (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At its Investor Forum (Ottawa) Ciena set three-year targets for fiscal year 2029: revenue CAGR of approximately 30% from 2026 through 2029, adjusted (non-GAAP) gross margin of approximately 50%, adjusted operating margin of 32% to 35%, and free cash flow margins of approximately 20%. CFO Marc Graff cited a differentiated portfolio, growing customer demand, expanding supply capacity and new addressable markets. From fiscal 2027 (starting with Q1 fiscal 2027 results) Ciena will report four segments: Optical Systems, Interconnects, Global Services, and Routing and Other.
